text: Poster at RSNA 2026 in Chicago (Nov 29 – Dec 3): LoRA versus full fine-tuning of a local LLM for bladder cancer survival predictors.
Oral talk accepted at SPIE Medical Imaging 2027 (Vancouver, Feb 2027): LoRA fine-tuning of a compact 3B LLM on complete perioperative records.
Started the M.S. in Computational Medicine & Bioinformatics at Michigan Medicine (accelerated master’s program).
Finished my software development internship with Amazon Alexa AI in Boston.
Became President of the Michigan Data Science Team.
Podium talk at SPIE Medical Imaging in Vancouver on fine-tuning a 3B LLM for clinical extraction.
Podium talk at RSNA 2025 in Chicago on a small LLM for bladder cancer survival predictors.
Invited talk at MIITT, Michigan Medicine: “Large Language Models in Clinical Workflows.”
Named a James B. Angell Scholar.
